title: The 16 Best Electric Kettles Under $50
metaDescription: Our 16 picks for electric kettles under $50, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at electric kettles under $50 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cosori Electric Gooseneck Kettle
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 preset temperatures from 140°F to 212°F, Gooseneck spout for controlled pour-over flow, 60-minute keep-warm function.
strengths: 60-minute keep-warm outlasts most budget and even some mid-range competitors' 20 to 30 minute windows
5 presets cover green tea, white tea, and pour-over coffee without needing a manual dial
limitations: ±3°F temperature accuracy is looser than premium gooseneck kettles' ±1°F
No counterweighted handle, so balance shifts slightly as the kettle empties
0.8L capacity requires refilling for teapot quantities or 3+ cup sessions
features: Gooseneck spout for controlled pour-over flow
1,500W element boils 1 liter in 3.5 to 4 minutes
Stainless steel body with auto-shutoff and boil-dry protection

products.name: Ovente Electric Kettle KS96 Stainless Steel
products.blurb: Key specs: Stainless steel interior, 1,500W element boils 1 liter in about 3.5 to 4 minutes, Auto-shutoff and boil-dry protection.
strengths: Stainless interior avoids the metallic taste some all-plastic budget kettles impart
Simple no-frills design means fewer components that can fail over years of use
limitations: No variable temperature control, unsuitable for green tea or pour-over coffee
No keep-warm function, water begins cooling immediately after auto-shutoff
Plastic exterior housing feels less premium than double-wall stainless competitors
features: 1,500W element boils 1 liter in about 3.5 to 4 minutes
